lesson_title: Posting: The Month Comes Home to the Ledger
hook_text: One question breaks the diary system: 'how much money do I HAVE?' The cabinet answers in seconds.
clip_script: Now ask the cabinet the owner's favourite question: how much money do we have? Open the Bank drawer: left page 56 900, right page 22 500. Difference: R34 400, sitting on the left — the business HAS thirty-four thousand four hundred rand. One drawer, one subtraction, instant answer — the very question the sorting room could never answer without re-reading the month. Do the same for Stock: 8 000 in, 3 600 out — R4 400 of goods on the shelf at cost. The cabinet knows everything, drawer by drawer.
visual_style: A wall of labelled drawers sliding open one by one, numbers flying in from two diary pages, the Bank drawer glowing as its balance computes on screen.
mood: Organised satisfaction — everything finding its place.
pacing: Rhythmic drawer-by-drawer build, pause on the Bank question, crisp answer landing.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and prove the whole month with the trial balance.
